name: Company lifepod
text: A Con-Reg lifepod on the company band, one aboard: the junior surveyor from the skiff you towed, let go for the fuel the tow cost and put out at the lanes with a lifepod and a reference.

choices.label: Sign Ama on
choices.result: Ama Osei comes aboard with her survey kit and the Company's reference, which says she is honest to a fault. You'll see.

choices.label: Drop her at the lanes
choices.result: You see her to a lanes station with a week's rations. She pays you in Company survey lines, which she shouldn't have and you can sell.

choices.label: Hand her to Recovery
choices.result: Recovery pays a finder's fee on Company property, lifepods included. She doesn't say anything as they take her off.

choices.label: Keep flying
choices.result: The pod's beacon blinks on the company band behind you.
